name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.7.19
body:
**Options** 
- new "Glazed" theme alternative to the default "Dark" theme.
- Experimental Firmware update now resides on the Dashboard.
- Options has moved from Expert to the gameID / Settings tab.
- Expert and Console tabs can now also be hidden in gameID / Settings -> Options.
- DonutShop Memory stats now hidden by default, enable in Options.
